item.title: OJS UPGRADE & MIGRATION TO VERSION 3
item.description: Dear Authors, Editors, and Reviewers of Jurnal Antropologi: Isu-Isu Sosial Budaya, We would like to inform you that our Open Journal System (OJS) is currently being upgraded and migrated to OJS 3. As a result of this process, the journal’s website interface will undergo changes. However, we assure you that all core functions, including submission, review, and publication processes, will continue to operate as usual.
